US Bans Canadian Dairy, Alcohol, Motorcycles in Trade Dispute

The United States announced bans on several Canadian imports, including dairy products, most alcoholic beverages, and motorcycles. This action is part of an escalating trade dispute between the two countries. The bans are a response to ongoing trade disagreements, with the US administration implementing these measures as part of a broader trade war.
